info.brief: Creates bounded two-dimensional Voronoi diagrams using jc_voronoi 0.10.0.
info.description: Creates bounded two-dimensional Voronoi diagrams using jc_voronoi 0.10.0.

elements.name: voronoi.create
elements.description: Creates a reusable Voronoi diagram context for a rectangular area.

parameters.name: width
parameters.doc: Width of the diagram bounds in coordinate units.

parameters.name: height
parameters.doc: Height of the diagram bounds in coordinate units.

returnvalues.name: diagram
returnvalues.doc: Diagram context passed to the other voronoi functions.

elements.name: voronoi.destroy
elements.description: Releases a diagram context. Do not use the context after destroying it.

elements.name: voronoi.generate
elements.description: Replaces the diagram with sites generated from a flat list of x/y coordinates. Duplicate sites may be removed.

parameters.name: points
parameters.doc: Flat coordinate array in the form { x1, y1, x2, y2, ... }.

elements.name: voronoi.relax
elements.description: Moves every input point toward the average of its site and cell vertices, then regenerates the diagram.

elements.name: voronoi.get_sites
elements.description: Returns every generated site. A site contains p, index, boundary, edges, and the convenience field area. The p field is { x, y }; index is the 1-based original input index; boundary reports whether the cell touches the clipping boundary; and edges contains counter-clockwise edge tables.
elements.examples: for _, site in ipairs(voronoi.get_sites(diagram)) do pprint(site) end

elements.name: voronoi.get_num_sites
elements.description: Returns diagram.numsites, the number of unique generated sites. This may be smaller than the input count when points are duplicated.

elements.name: voronoi.get_site
elements.description: Returns the generated site for a 1-based original input index. The site has the same fields as entries returned by get_sites().

returnvalues.name: site
returnvalues.doc: Site table for the requested input point.

elements.name: voronoi.get_num_vertices
elements.description: Returns diagram.numvertices, the number of unique Voronoi vertices.

elements.name: voronoi.get_vertices
elements.description: Returns all unique Voronoi vertices as { x, y } point tables. Edge vertex indices refer to this array.

elements.name: voronoi.get_edges
elements.description: Returns every diagram edge. Each edge contains sites, pos, and vertices. sites contains two 1-based input indices, with 0 denoting the clipping boundary. pos contains two { x, y } endpoints. vertices contains two 1-based indices into get_vertices(), with 0 denoting an invalid endpoint.

elements.name: voronoi.get_delauney_edges
elements.description: Returns the Delauney edges produced by the upstream jcv_delauney iterator. Each entry contains edge, sites, and pos fields matching jcv_delauney_edge. The upstream spelling "delauney" is preserved in the Lua function name.

elements.name: voronoi.get_debug_image
elements.description: Rasterizes the current diagram into an RGB buffer matching the context dimensions.

returnvalues.name: image
returnvalues.doc: Buffer with a uint8 rgb stream containing three components per pixel.
